name: demo-03-fib-caller
description: Demo 03: EVM Solidity contract calls Rust PVM contract for Fibonacci computation

scripts.build:rust: cd rust-contract && cargo build --release && polkatool link --strip target/riscv64emac-unknown-none-polkavm/release/fibonacci -o fibonacci.polkavm
scripts.demo:all: npm run build:rust && npm run compile && npm run demo
